    def admit(self, i, pkt):
        """Rank, classify, route and stage one packet attempt.

        The rank is assigned on every attempt, so FIFO/WFQ state advances even
        when admission then fails.  Returns ``(accepted, rank, lb, r, bank)``.
        """
        rank = self.policy.rank_cal(pkt)
        pkt.rank = rank
        M = self.M
        R = self.R
        r = self.classify(rank)
        lb = self.l
        self.l = lb + 1
        if self.l >= self.L:
            self.l = 0
        base = lb * M * R + r
        C = self.C
        best = C[base]
        bank = 0
        for q in range(1, M):
            value = C[base + q * R]
            if value < best:
                best = value
                bank = q
        used = self.fbytes[bank]
        accepted = used + pkt.length <= self.fifo_cap
        if accepted:
            pkt.bank = bank
            pkt.slot = self._stage_append(bank, pkt)
            self.fbytes[bank] = used + pkt.length
            self.fcnt[bank] += 1
            self.registry[pkt.pktid] = pkt
            self.live = fat_insert(self.live, (rank, i), pkt,
                                   self.priors.take(), self.ver)
            C[base + bank * R] += 1
            self.a += 1
            if self.a == self.period:
                self.sample_due = i
        return accepted, rank, lb, r, bank

    def cmd_enqueue(self, i, ev, log):
        pkt = Pkt(ev[1], ev[2], ev[3], ev[4])
        pkt.oid = i
        accepted, rank, lb, r, bank = self.admit(i, pkt)
        log.append([i, 'enqueue', pkt.pktid, rank, lb, r, bank, accepted])
        if self.sample_due == i:
            self.sample_due = -1
            self.cmd_sample(i, log)

    def _visit(self, i, log):
        """One service opportunity: bank p only, then the tick advances."""
        M = self.M
        old_t = self.t
        q = self.p
        nxt = q + 1
        self.p = 0 if nxt >= M else nxt
        self.t = old_t + 1
        if self.pifo[q] is not None:
            # The head is served and frees its bytes before a refill.
            self.pifo[q], node = lean_extract_min(self.pifo[q], self.ver)
            pkt = node[1]
            self.pbytes[q] -= pkt.length
            self.policy.post_dequeue(pkt, pkt.rank)
            evicted = self._refill(q)
            self._complete_service(q, pkt, evicted, i, old_t, log)
            return pkt
        evicted = self._refill(q)
        root = self.pifo[q]
        if root is not None:
            self.pifo[q], node = lean_extract_min(root, self.ver)
            pkt = node[1]
            self.pbytes[q] -= pkt.length
            self.policy.post_dequeue(pkt, pkt.rank)
            self._complete_service(q, pkt, evicted, i, old_t, log)
            return pkt
        log.append([i, 'dequeue', old_t, q, None, None, 0, 0, evicted])
        return None

    def cmd_dequeue(self, i, count, log):
        for _ in range(count):
            self._visit(i, log)

    def cmd_sample(self, i, log):
        C = self.C
        R = self.R
        M = self.M
        L = self.L
        span = M * R
        X = [0] * R
        for r in range(R):
            X[r] = sum(C[r::R])
        for l in range(L):
            low = l * span
            for r in range(R):
                column = C[low + r:low + span:R]
                smallest = min(column)
                if smallest:
                    for q in range(M):
                        C[low + q * R + r] -= smallest
        H = self.H
        for r in range(R):
            H[r] = H[r] // 2 + X[r]
        self.a = 0
        log.append([i, 'sample', X, H[:]])
